connector.name: knowmind by Schubeler-Consulting
connector.registryDescription: AI agent memory & knowledge graph, hosted in Germany (GDPR). Recall, relations, store via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package knowmind. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the schubeler-consulting account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KNOWMIND_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer API token from the knowmind.de Dashboard -> API-Tokens (https://knowmind.de/dashboard/api-tokens)
